audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with their own whys[] text: Level 3 read Jayce while whys[2] calls it skill-decided, Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says he controls every trade, First item read Skill while whys[5] says he still out-pokes you, and 2+ items read Jayce while whys[6] says your gap-close overwhelms his range. Difficulty read EVEN with a red tone, an 8.5/10 rating and a 'Hard matchup' summary, on a 49.09% win rate over 4677 games.
audit.why: The packet agrees with the prose on six of seven rows; only Level 6 differs, and there whys[4] explicitly says Jayce stays ahead, so I kept Jayce.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Yone; difficulty TRICKY at 7.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere on a page built entirely around waiting out one ability.
audit.why: Shock Blast runs 16/14/12/10/8/6 seconds — it is a genuine 16-second window at rank 1 and effectively a permanent one by rank 6, which is exactly why the lane slips away as levels go on. Thundering Blow is 20 seconds at rank 1 falling to 10. The stance swap itself is 6 seconds and resets his auto. Your Soul Unbound falls 22s to 10s; Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The punish window shrinks from 16 seconds to 6 across the game — commit early inside it rather than planning to out-wait him later.

audit.whatIsWrong: Acceleration Gate is called his W in spikes[0], whys[1] and wants.foe[0]; Spirit Cleave is described as sustain that heals chip damage in spikes[3] and late; Fate Sealed is described as setting up team knockups.
audit.why: Acceleration Gate is the Cannon-form E — a Shock Blast fired through it gains missile speed, range AND damage, which is what makes the poke unfair rather than the gate itself. His W in Cannon form is Hyper Charge (attack speed) and in Hammer form Lightning Field. Spirit Cleave grants a shield, not healing — Riot's text says shield and the kit carries no heal flag, so 'Cleave sustain healing his chip' is wrong in kind. Thundering Blow is the Hammer E knockback, 20s at rank 1. The stance swap is an auto-attack reset, and the first attack after swapping to Cannon shreds your armour and MR — the wind-up is the tell, not the swap animation. Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls.
audit.corrected: Names and slots corrected; Spirit Cleave described as a shield; the gate's effect on Shock Blast stated explicitly.

notes: Two real errors beyond the chart. First, Acceleration Gate was called his W in three places — it is the Cannon-form E, and the reason it matters is that a Shock Blast fired through it gains missile speed, range and damage, which the page never said. Second, Spirit Cleave was described as sustain that heals his chip damage in two places; it grants a shield. Also added the shrinking Shock Blast cooldown (16s at rank 1 to 6s at max), which explains why the lane gets harder rather than easier, and Thundering Blow's 20s as the number to bait before you commit Fate Sealed. Four chart rows flipped in matched pairs; the only row where I departed from the packet is Level 6, where this page's own whys[4] says Jayce stays ahead.
